parsed.title: Daily Task for AI Usage Credits
parsed.oneLiner: Play a 15-second mini-game with Luzia to earn daily AI usage credits.

newMechanic.name: Daily Tasks
newMechanic.description: A new interactive banner on the Chats Home (s01) screen offering daily mini-game challenges for AI usage credits.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Increases daily engagement and retention for non-subscribers by gamifying AI usage while protecting margins.

parsed.trigger: User taps the Daily Task banner on the Chats Home (s01) tab, outside of their first session.
parsed.eligibility: Returning non-subscribers (session 2+), once per day per user.

offer.title: Daily Task: Earn Credits
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second mini-game with Luzia to earn 2 extra AI usage credits.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Only offered to non-subscribers and returning users (session 2+). Credits are additive to the usage quota and do not unlock the advanced capabilities or reasoning modes of the Luzia+ subscription. The reward is sized to maintain a healthy margin per view.
risks: If not rotated, mini-game tasks may become repetitive.
Potential for users to rely on ad-earned credits instead of subscribing if limits are miscalculated.

newElements.change: Add a Daily Task banner element to provide a clear entry point for rewarded mini-games.

storyboard.caption: Returning users browse and start chats on the Home tab.
We add a new Daily Task banner for a rewarding mini-game.
Users opt-in to a 15-second game for 2 AI credits.
The user plays the mini-game with Luzia.
Upon completion, the user receives 2 AI usage credits.
